sentences.text: 2. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the cousin sister of the informant was married to the son of the applicant around one year ago and sufficient dowry was also given, subsequently, the cousin sister of the informant had committed suicide on 30.05.2024.
The post mortem report indicates the cause of death as ante mortem hanging and apart from the ligature mark, contusion and abrasion injuries were observed on the left knee and the left ankle.
The applicant is the mother in law.
3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.
Bhagwanta @ Bhagwana vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Bhagwanta @ Bhagwana vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Considering the fact that there is nothing on record to demonstrate that soon before the death,
the deceased was subjected to any mental and physical harassment in relation to the demand of dowry, the applicant who is aged about 60 years and is in custody since 29.06.2024, is enlarged on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Bhagwanta @ Bhagwana be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 156 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304-B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Umeribegumganj,
District Gonda, on her furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which she is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade her from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 10.9.2024 Arun  Bhagwanta @ Bhagwana vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
